about_the_game:
Explore a haunted dollhouse using supernatural powers, unlock terrifying rooms, and survive together—or alone. Every playthrough is different. Every decision matters. And no one is safe.

Step into the haunted dollhouse.

You are part of a group of parapsychology students gifted with the Sight, a supernatural ability that reveals what lies beyond the living. When your professor disappears leaving behind a dollhouse filled with locked rooms, you’re drawn into an unfolding nightmare.

Haunted is a cooperative multiplayer horror experience that blurs the line between puzzle-solving and survival. Communicate, investigate, and confront the entities that stalk the cursed halls of Woodman Manor — a place where not even the walls can be trusted.

🕯️ Each playthrough is unique.
Rooms unlock progressively, revealing new puzzles, spirits, and artifacts. Every session offers fresh layouts, clues, and threats that evolve depending on your choices, your coordination — and your silence.

🧑‍🤝‍🧑 Co-op at your own risk.
Play with up to three friends. Coordinate your actions — but be careful what you say: Some entities are always listening.

🔀 Built for replayability.
Procedural elements ensure a new layout and challenge every run. Uncover the story of the Woodman Family, the origins of the curse, and the horrors bound to the dollhouse — again and again.

Key Features

  • 2–4 Player Asymmetrical Co-op – One supervises from outside, others explore within.

  • Voice-Based Puzzles & Proximity Chat – Communication is your lifeline.

  • Procedural Replayability – Every run brings new scares, entities, and story fragments.

  • Ongoing Content Roadmap – Expanding rooms, entities, and supernatural abilities through Early Access.

Will you uncover the truth, or become just another whisper in the walls?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10+
  • Processor: Intel@ Core i5 2300 or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GT 640, HD 6750 or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10+
  • Processor: Intel@ Core i7 2600 or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 660; HD 7850 or better
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

short_description: Enter a cursed Victorian dollhouse in this co-op horror experience. Use supernatural powers, solve twisted puzzles, and survive haunted rooms that change with every run. Communication is your only hope—or your doom.
